mapper.insert: insert into CHB_AST_VAL ( VAL_ID, ISSUE_PARTY_ID, ASSET_CODE, VAL_DATE, UNIT_VAL_NET, UNIT_VAL_TOTAL, REMARK, DATASOURCE, STATUS, WORKFLOW_ID, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) values ( #{valId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{issuePartyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{assetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{valDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{unitValNet,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{unitValTotal,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{datasource,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(), #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now() )
mapper.select:
with price as ( SELECT BASIS_CYY CCY,
OPEN_PRICE PRICE CLOSE_PRICE PRICE HIGH_PRICE PRICE LOW_PRICE PRICE MID_PRICE PRICE
FROM ( select t.*,row_number() over(partition by BASIS_CYY order by TRADE_DATE DESC) myrank from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE t where t.TRADE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') and QUOT_CYY='CNY' and DATASOURCE_TYPE='SAFE' )as t WHERE myrank=1 ) select assetCode, valDate, ROUND(unitValNet,4) unitValNet, ROUND(unitValTotal,4) unitValTotal, CCY from (select assetbasis.assetCode, assetbasis.valueDate valDate,
(ifnull(price.PRICE,1) * (case typex.SRCFIELD1 when 'NOMONEYFOUND' then (costAmt+floatingpl)/posAmt when 'MONEYFOUND' then (case info.TRM_FUND_TYPE when '01' then 100 when '05' then 0.01 else 1 end) when 'STOCK' then (costAmt+floatingpl)/posAmt when 'DERIVATIVE' then (costAmt+floatingpl) when 'OPTION' then (costAmt+floatingpl) else if(assetbasis.valueDate=assetbasis.mdate,100,100*costAmt/posAmt) end )) unitValNet, (ifnull(price.PRICE,1) * (case typex.SRCFIELD1 when 'MONEYFOUND' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp)/posAmt when 'NOMONEYFOUND' then (costAmt+floatingpl)/posAmt when 'STOCK' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp)/posAmt when 'DERIVATIVE' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp)/posAmt when 'OPTION' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp) else if(assetbasis.valueDate=assetbasis.mdate,100,100*(costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp)/posAmt) end )) unitValTotal, assetbasis.CCY from (select ASSET_ID assetCode, VALUE_DATE valueDate, CCY ccy, MDATE mdate, sum(ifnull(TDY_COST_AMT,0)) costAmt, sum(ifnull(TDY_INTINCEXP,0)) intincexp, sum(ifnull(POS_AMT,0)) posAmt, sum(ifnull(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)) floatingpl
FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA basis
FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA_NOBTM basis
where VALUE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') and basis.status !='D' and pos_amt != 0 and pos_amt is not null group by ASSET_ID,VALUE_DATE,MDATE,CCY) assetbasis left join CHB_ASSET_INFO info on info.ASSET_CODE = assetbasis.assetCode left join price on price.CCY = assetbasis.CCY left join CHB_TYPE_MAPPING_EX typex on typex.OBJFIELD1 = info.ORG_ASSET_TYPE1 and ((typex.OBJFIELD2 = info.ORG_ASSET_TYPE2) or typex.OBJFIELD2 is null) and ((typex.OBJFIELD3 = info.ORG_ASSET_TYPE3) or typex.OBJFIELD3 is null) /***对于债券类资产，需要根据其登记托管机构配置哪些生成估值信息登记 add by leipeng 20210129***/ and ((typex.OBJFIELD4 = info.REGIST_ORG) or typex.OBJFIELD4 is null) /***对于债券类资产，需要根据其登记托管机构配置哪些生成估值信息登记 add by leipeng 20210129***/ and typex.MAPPINGCODE='ASSETBASISTYPE'
left join chb_asset_info_sub csb on csb.ASSET_CODE=assetbasis.assetCode LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_SUB_STATUS CS ON csb.REGIST_SEQNO=CS.REGIST_SEQNO AND CS.ASSET_TYPE='01'
where 1=1 and (assetbasis.posAmt <> 0 or assetbasis.valueDate=assetbasis.mdate) and assetbasis.assetCode is not null /**add by dxy 光大个性化改造 统计UAP类型资产 20220505 start*/ and info.DATA_SOURCE !='SAMS' /**add by dxy 光大个性化改造 统计UAP类型资产 20220505 end*/
and CS.INSTITUTION_CODE =#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
) as t where unitValNet is not null /**add by dxy 光大个性化改造 统计SAMS类型资产 20220505 start*/ union all select assetCode, valDate, ROUND(unitValNet,4) unitValNet, ROUND(unitValTotal,4) unitValTotal from (select distinct assetbasis.assetCode, assetbasis.valueDate valDate, (ifnull(price.PRICE,1) * (case IFNULL(typex.SRCFIELD1,typex1.SRCFIELD1) when 'NOMONEYFOUND' then (costAmt+floatingpl)/posAmt when 'MONEYFOUND' then (case info.TRM_FUND_TYPE when '01' then 100 when '05' then 0.01 else 1 end) when 'STOCK' then (costAmt+floatingpl)/posAmt when 'DERIVATIVE' then (costAmt+floatingpl) when 'OPTION' then (costAmt+floatingpl) else if(assetbasis.valueDate=assetbasis.mdate,100,100*costAmt/posAmt) end )) unitValNet, (ifnull(price.PRICE,1) * (case IFNULL(typex.SRCFIELD1,typex1.SRCFIELD1) when 'MONEYFOUND' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp)/posAmt when 'NOMONEYFOUND' then (costAmt+floatingpl)/posAmt when 'STOCK' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp)/posAmt when 'DERIVATIVE' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp)/posAmt when 'OPTION' then (costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp) else if(assetbasis.valueDate=assetbasis.mdate,100,100*(costAmt+floatingpl+intincexp)/posAmt) end )) unitValTotal from (select ASSET_ID assetCode, VALUE_DATE valueDate, CCY ccy, MDATE mdate, sum(ifnull(TDY_COST_AMT,0)) costAmt, sum(ifnull(TDY_INTINCEXP,0)) intincexp, sum(ifnull(POS_AMT,0)) posAmt, sum(ifnull(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)) floatingpl
FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA basis
FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA_NOBTM basis
where VALUE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') and basis.status !='D' and pos_amt != 0 and pos_amt is not null group by ASSET_ID,VALUE_DATE,MDATE,CCY) assetbasis left join CHB_ASSET_INFO info on info.ASSET_CODE = assetbasis.assetCode left join price on price.CCY = assetbasis.CCY LEFT JOIN CHB_TYPE_MAPPING_EX typex ON typex.OBJFIELD2 = info.ORG_ASSET_TYPE2 AND ((typex.OBJFIELD3 = info.ORG_ASSET_TYPE3) OR typex.OBJFIELD3 IS NULL) and info.ORG_ASSET_TYPE5 is null AND typex.MAPPINGCODE='ASSETBASISTYPE' LEFT JOIN CHB_TYPE_MAPPING_EX typex1 ON typex1.OBJFIELD4 = info.ORG_ASSET_TYPE5 AND typex1.MAPPINGCODE='ASSETBASISTYPE'
left join chb_asset_info_sub csb on csb.ASSET_CODE=assetbasis.assetCode LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_SUB_STATUS CS ON csb.REGIST_SEQNO=CS.REGIST_SEQNO AND CS.ASSET_TYPE='01'
where 1=1 and (assetbasis.posAmt <> 0 or assetbasis.valueDate=assetbasis.mdate) and assetbasis.assetCode is not null and info.DATA_SOURCE='SAMS'
and CS.INSTITUTION_CODE =#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
) as t where unitValNet is not null /**add by dxy 光大个性化改造 统计SAMS类型资产 20220505 end*/

SELECT basis.assetCode, basis.valDate, ROUND(basis.unitValNet,4) unitValNet, ROUND(basis.unitValTotal,4) unitValTotal, basis.CCY FROM ( SELECT basis.Asset_Id assetCode, basis.Value_Date valDate, AVG(basis.UNIT_VAL_NET) unitValNet, AVG(basis.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL) unitValTotal, basis.CCY FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA basis where VALUE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') and basis.status !='D' and pos_amt != 0 and pos_amt is not null AND basis.Pos_Amt IS NOT NULL and (basis.REMARK is null OR basis.REMARK = '') GROUP BY basis.Asset_Id,basis.Value_Date ) basis where unitValNet is not null

SELECT basis.Asset_Id assetCode, basis.Value_Date valDate, basis.UNIT_VAL_NET unitValNet, basis.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL unitValTotal, basis.CCY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY basis.Asset_Id ORDER BY basis.REMARK DESC ,basis.PROD_ID ASC) dataNum, basis.eremark FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA basis where VALUE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') and basis.status !='D' and pos_amt != 0 and pos_amt is not null AND basis.Pos_Amt IS NOT NULL and (basis.REMARK is NOT null AND basis.REMARK != '') ORDER BY basis.Asset_Id DESC ,basis.REMARK DESC ,basis.PROD_ID ASC

SELECT ccy FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA basis where VALUE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') and basis.status !='D' and pos_amt != 0 and pos_amt is not null AND basis.Pos_Amt IS NOT NULL AND UNIT_VAL_NET IS NOT NULL group by ccy
